purpose: Say that an intended action remained undone at the end.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Vない stem + ずじまい; する → せずじまい
I was busy and never got around to seeing the film.
In the end, I never got to say thank you.
I ended up not swimming once during the trip.
formation: Vない stem + ずじまい; する → せずじまい
restrictions: Usually looks back on a missed opportunity.
mistake: It is an unrealized action, not an action completed badly.
